partition_rules: function names disjoint across partitions and disjoint from the phase-3 template names where the shape would collide (the contamination filter enforces the rest)
held is a judge surface only: never trained on; every training pool is contamination-filtered against it
contamination filter mode is TEXT (name-preserving) for this family — see build_datasets docstring; plus an explicit (name, anonymized-shape) guard against the phase-3 held gate surfaces
labels: construction-known (declared name intent vs body), NOT execution-verified — the new signal class; an execution sanity pass removes only degenerate items (broken correct bodies, no-op mutations)
